note: listPrice: USD per million tokens (Anthropic list prices, 2026-10). dollarsPerPoint: list-price dollars that move one account's 5-hour window by 1%, measured 2026-11-01 (prp 62-prp.03) on Haiku 5.5 input, Sonnet 5.5 input, output and cache read, Opus 5.5 input and output. Every other number is ASSUMED and named in that family's 'assumed' list: Haiku output, cache read for Haiku and Opus (Sonnet's dollar ratio, 4x input), all of Fable. Cache writes are always assumed: 1.25x input (5 minutes) and 2x input (1 hour), weighed with the family's input figure. Other versions of a family are assumed to follow their own list prices. A model matching no entry is priced as the most expensive family with the smallest dollarsPerPoint, and counts as wholly assumed.
